name: INX Digital Company
rootCause: On December 20, 2023, INX Digital Company suffered a loss of approximately $1.6 million after a third-party service provider was breached. The incident was reportedly due to an infrastructure key compromise, but customer funds and personal data on INX platforms remained secure. A third-party service provider holding infrastructure keys for an INX subsidiary was breached, leading to unauthorized transactions and a loss of $1.6 million. This constitutes an infrastructure-level key compromise, not a direct smart contract or application vulnerability at INX itself.
